description: This Java class 'NewKeyForm' provides a user interface and logic for creating and managing cryptographic keys and certificates for Android signing, including keystore handling, certificate details, and key generation.

classes.name: NewKeyForm
classes.description: An abstract class providing UI and logic for creating and managing Android keystore keys and certificates, including key generation, validation, and loading keystore entries.

methods.name: NewKeyForm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the validity spinner model.

methods.name: getValidity
methods.description: Returns the validity period for the certificate in years.

methods.description: Initializes the form by generating a default alias.

methods.name: getContentPanel
methods.description: Returns the main content panel of the form.

methods.name: findNonEmptyCertificateField
methods.description: Checks if any certificate detail fields are non-empty.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Validates input and initiates key creation process, throwing exceptions on errors.

methods.description: Performs the actual key creation, handling errors and loading keystore.

methods.description: Loads the keystore and retrieves the private key and certificate for the given alias.
